nodes.label: EPIC 00: Book outline, perspectives, dev philosophy
Three analysis perspectives: Booth, Player, Spectator
nodes.rationale: Booth view (god mode, all hands visible — coded first), Player view (single known hand, leads to GTO/range thinking and the AJo+ DSL), Spectator view (no hands visible, requires stacks/blinds/bet data). Domain-first development: lock down pure card-odds analysis before bets and stack sizes.
